references.text: The land shall rest and enjoy its sabbath years while it lies desolate. This verse explains how the land will make up for the sabbaths that were not kept.
The fulfillment of the prophecy that the land would rest and enjoy its sabbath years during the exile in Babylon, until seventy years had passed.
The same expression about despising God's laws and abhorring His statutes is used here as a warning and repeated in verse 43 as the cause of the punishment.
Isaiah describes how the land mourns and the people bear their guilt because of transgression against the law and breaking the everlasting covenant.
Jeremiah speaks of how the people abandoned God's law, did not listen to His voice, but followed the stubbornness of their own hearts.
Isaiah describes the people's sin and how they have despised the Holy One of Israel and turned away from Him.
The commands regarding sabbath years for the land, which the people did not keep, leading to the land having to rest during the exile.
